focal_recovery.counts_interpretation: Descriptive reviewed-record coverage; excluded from inference.
focal_recovery.model_pairing_interpretation: Both infection groups occur in original model records from the same reviewed experiment. Their retained target species may differ.

record_count_caveat: Distinct published analyses of one experiment remain distinct raw model records. They do not increase the independent experiment count.
method: Explicit source-reviewed adjudications, deterministic exact evidence validation and preserved raw model records.
